transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the Northstar capital-call review. As you know, we have an $8,000,000 capital commitment to the Northstar Private Credit Fund, and the current call notice is requesting the full $8,000,000, payable within 10 business days. The draft plan proposes funding this entirely from operating cash. Before I sign off on the funding instruction, I need each of you — investment operations, legal, treasury, and tax — to report any exceptions or implementation requirements from your areas. Let's go around the table.
